title: The Surplus
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Surplus,' the office discusses the budget surplus, with Michael deciding to keep the extra funds as a bonus and ultimately agreeing to buy new chairs after team input. Meanwhile, relationships and humorous moments unfold, including Pam and Jim's interactions and Dwight and Angela's fake marriage. The episode ends with Michael's decision to withhold the surplus, leaving some outcomes uncertain.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: You can see clearly on this page that we have a surplus of $4300.
Michael: Guess what, everybody? Christmas has come early this year. Oscar, very smartly, has discovered an extra $4300 in the budget.
Michael: I hate disappointing just one person. And I really hate disappointing everyone. But I love Burlington Coat Factory.
Michael: I have made my decision. We do not need a new copier. We do not need new chairs.
Pam: You're gonna give yourself a bonus of $645 instead of getting the entire office something it really needs?
Pam: So what's it gonna be?
Pam: Hey.
Jim: Hey.
Oscar (laughing uproariously with Michael and Jim): Stop it! Michael.
Jim: You look really pretty.
Pam: Oh, that must've been so fun.
Michael: Yeah.
